stage: First unedited drafts, frozen before lint measurement or either scrub run
inputs: Coordinator-supplied fictional facts, names and numeric allowlists in each .facts.json
length: 150 to 350 words per draft, target 180 to 230
conditions: No skill, checklist, previous fixture, result or repository guide loaded by the writer
No edits or scrub after first generation
Use digits for quantities and only supplied concrete facts
The writer reports length or fact failures instead of silently replacing a draft
scope: A constructed style exercise, separate from the first thin-fact batch; no detector score or population-wide performance claim
